get.description: Liveness probe — returns 200 if the app is running.

Readiness probe — checks all downstream dependencies.
Returns 200 only if vector DB, LLM gateway, and database are reachable.

Pipeline health — lightweight ping of each demo component.

Used by the demo dry-run to confirm the full pipeline is live
before presenting. Each check is a no-op import/config validation,
NOT a full request to the downstream service.

SSE streaming search — yields typed events as results arrive from HindsightRAGService.

Uses the httpx-based Hindsight REST client (Pyodide/Workers-safe).
Delegates to HindsightRAGService.query() for 4-way hybrid search (dense + BM25 +
semantic reranking + graph).

Event types:
  result  — one RAG chunk with selected provenance fields:
            {"id", "text", "type", "chunk_id", "entities", "rank",
             "document_id", "source_url", "source_title", "source_language"}
  error   — upstream failure: {"message": "<str>"}
  done    — end-of-stream sentinel: "[DONE]"

post.description: Stream grounded results, runtime model metadata, answer chunks, and `done`.

Accept a document upload, run OCR extraction, and return structured page results.

- Validates content type; rejects anything other than PDF/DOCX/PNG with HTTP 422.
- Reads the file entirely into memory; no disk writes occur (EPHEMERAL guarantee).
- Passes bytes to OCRService (Mistral OCR primary, Tesseract fallback).
- Returns per-page OCR text and confidence scores.
- target_lang is accepted for downstream translation by TranslationService.

get.description: Retrieve metadata and processing status for an uploaded document.

Retrieve classification metadata for an uploaded document.

The current implementation uses an in-memory metadata seam until D1-backed
document persistence lands. Missing IDs return 404 rather than fabricating data.
Download the layout-preserved translated version of a document.

post.description:
Send a document to a Matrix room.

Validates feature flag (403 if off). Uploads file to Matrix homeserver
and sends file event to the specified room. Deletes file bytes reference
before returning (GDPR NFR-04).

Returns {"event_id": str, "room_id": str, "ephemeral": true}.

schema.title: Response Send Document Api V1 Exchange Send Post

post.description:
Create a secure Matrix room and invite participants.

Validates all participant IDs as Matrix user IDs (@user:domain.tld).
Returns {"room_id": str}.

schema.title: Response Create Room Api V1 Exchange Rooms Post
